ref_extractions.title: Simultaneous MRI-EEG during a motor imagery neurofeedback task: an open access brain imaging dataset for multi-modal data integration
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This is the bioRxiv preprint of the dataset descriptor paper for ds002338 (XP2) and ds002336 (XP1). It describes the dataset structure, experimental paradigm (Rest and Task-NF blocks), and mentions prospective ML uses but does not actually implement a concrete ML classification task with defined labels.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Dataset descriptor paper describing 30 subjects across XP1/XP2, 64-channel EEG at 5kHz, Rest vs Task-NF experimental design. Mentions potential for machine learning and multimodal integration but does not execute ML analysis.

ref_extractions.title: Simultaneous EEG-fMRI during a neurofeedback task, a brain imaging dataset for multimodal data integration
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Published Scientific Data descriptor for the same dataset (XP1: ds002336, XP2: ds002338). Documents the dataset architecture, acquisition parameters, and experimental paradigm. While it discusses prospective ML uses for NF score estimation and multimodal fusion, no concrete ML classification task is implemented.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: BIDS-standardized dataset description with 27 public subjects, 64-channel EEG at 5kHz, MRI acquisition details. Computed EEG/fMRI NF scores as derivatives but did not define a classification task on Rest vs Task-NF blocks.

ref_extractions.title: Learning 2-in-1: Towards Integrated EEG-fMRI-Neurofeedback
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper presents original experimental work comparing 1D vs 2D integrated feedback strategies in bimodal EEG-fMRI-NF. It references the authors' prior study (Perronnet et al., 2017) but does not use the openneuro_ds002338 dataset. The study describes new experimental data collection.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Methods paper about feedback visualization strategies, not dataset analysis. BiDim (n=10) vs UniDim (n=10) group design, original experimental data.

ref_extractions.title: Simultaneous MRI-EEG during a motor imagery neurofeedback task: an open access brain imaging dataset for multi-modal data integration
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Duplicate bioRxiv preprint of the dataset descriptor. Same as 862375.full.pdf - describes ds002338 (XP2) and ds002336 (XP1), discusses experimental paradigm and potential uses but does not implement ML classification.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Preprint version of dataset descriptor paper, 30 subjects, 64-channel EEG, Rest/Task-NF paradigm.

ref_extractions.title: Interactions between emotions and eating behaviors: Main issues, neuroimaging contributions, and innovative preventive or corrective strategies
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Review article on emotional eating and neuroimaging. Completely unrelated to the motor imagery EEG-fMRI neurofeedback dataset. No connection to ds002338.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Review paper on emotions, eating behavior, and neuroimaging techniques including EEG/fMRI but not related to this dataset.

ref_extractions.title: Neural modulation enhancement using connectivity-based EEG neurofeedback with simultaneous fMRI for emotion regulation
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Original research on connectivity-based EEG neurofeedback for emotion regulation using positive autobiographical memories. Uses a different dataset with 10 healthy subjects (experimental group 1), not ds002338.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Emotion regulation study, different experimental paradigm and subjects. No use of openneuro_ds002338.

ref_extractions.title: Simultaneous EEG-fMRI during a neurofeedback task, a brain imaging dataset for multimodal data integration
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Duplicate of the Scientific Data publication. Same dataset descriptor for ds002338 (XP2) and ds002336 (XP1). Describes dataset structure and prospective ML uses without implementing concrete ML classification.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Published dataset descriptor in Nature Scientific Data, same content as other descriptor files.

ref_extractions.title: Two is better? combining EEG and fMRI for BCI and neurofeedback: a systematic review
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Systematic review article surveying EEG-fMRI combinations for BCI and neurofeedback. Does not use or analyze any specific dataset including ds002338.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Review article summarizing EEG-fMRI NF literature, not dataset analysis.

ref_extractions.title: A Multi-Target Motor Imagery Training Using Bimodal EEG-fMRI Neurofeedback: A Pilot Study in Chronic Stroke Patients
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Original pilot study applying bimodal EEG-fMRI NF to 4 chronic stroke patients. Different study population and experimental paradigm from ds002338 which uses healthy subjects performing motor imagery NF.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Different study: stroke patients, multi-target training approach, original data collection not using openneuro_ds002338.

ref_extractions.title: Toward an Adapted Neurofeedback for Post-stroke Motor Rehabilitation: State of the Art and Perspectives
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Narrative literature review on neurofeedback for post-stroke motor rehabilitation. Does not use or analyze the openneuro_ds002338 dataset.
ref_extractions.evidence_desc: Review article summarizing NFB for stroke rehabilitation literature.

feasibility_reason: Multiple 'partial' references confirm the motor imagery neurofeedback paradigm with Rest vs Task-NF binary design, and the analysis.md provides a well-defined event structure (Rest and Task-NF events with 20s blocks) suitable for binary classification. The dataset has clear label structure despite MRI artifacts requiring exclusion.
tasks_section:
## Tasks

### Potential Task 1: Rest vs Motor Imagery Neurofeedback Binary Classification
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_long_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = 0 s, tmax = 20 s, overlap = 0.0 *, target_events = [`Rest`, `Task-NF`]
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**:
  | Event | y | Meaning |
  |-------|---|---------|
  | `Rest` | 0 | Rest / baseline block |
  | `Task-NF` | 1 | Motor imagery neurofeedback task block |
- **Evidence**:
  - DOI: 10.1038/s41597-020-0498-3 — dataset descriptor confirming 20s alternating Rest and Task-NF blocks; reports NF scores derived from EEG but does not perform classification
  - DOI: 10.1101/862375 — preprint version of descriptor; same content
  - Paradigm alignment: block-design paradigm with 20s Rest and 20s Task-NF per DOI 10.1038/s41597-020-0498-3; S 99 indicates Rest onset, S 2 indicates Task onset
- **Kernel Notes**: Exclude MRI artifact markers (TPULSE/*, Response/R128, admin Stimulus codes). Downsample from 5000 Hz to 200-500 Hz for ML. No explicit classification paper exists for this dataset; task is plausible from paradigm structure alone. Verify event detection on raw data before epoching. Ensure 64-channel consistency across subjects.
